title: SLO Cohort Orchestrator and Dynamic Error-Budget Policy for Roadmap Alignment
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Build an orchestration layer and tracking conventions that map grouped SLIs ("cohorts") to roadmap waves and allow controlled transfers of error budget between initiatives. This ticket defines the end-to-end initiative lifecycle: cohort definition, visibility in Console dashboards, transfer policy for unused/overdrawn budgets, gating for rollouts, and a minimal automation to enact temporary throttles or canary rollbacks when budgets approach depletion.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Product and platform teams can declare SLI cohorts (service, route, and workload tags) and associate them to one or more initiatives in the Console UI.
A2: Error budget ledger shows per-initiative burn rate and projected runway with a 14-day forecast for each cohort.
A3: Owners can submit a one-time 'budget transfer' request that routes to PM and SRE approval flows and is recorded in the initiative ledger.

A4: A guarded automation will trigger a configurable canary rollback or throttle policy when budget runway falls below 48 hours; it must require a secondary approver for automated rollbacks in production-facing customers.
A5: Linear tickets for initiative work are auto-linked from the Console when an initiative key is entered; demo available to stakeholders.
A6: Documentation and on-call playbook published to Confluence with runbook steps for manual intervention.
A7: Unit and integration tests for the automation path with simulated SLI burn scenarios exist in the PR and pass CI.
A8: Stakeholder review completed with sign-off from Platform SRE and Product Security.
A9: Metrics surfaced: per-initiative SLI, burn rate, projected runway, number of active transfers, and last-approval actor.
A10: Migration plan for 5 pilot initiatives scheduled and owners notified.
A11: Updated incident postmortem template includes initiative context and error-budget state at time of incident.
A12: Updated the 'Reliability Initiative Hub' roadmap entry with milestones and launch checklist.
A13: Updated OKR mapping document links each initiative to a measurable reliability KR.
A14: Updated Console RBAC ensures only authorized roles can enact budget transfers or approve automated rollback triggers.
